title: Unitary Heisenberg Group over a Finite Field
body_html:
Unitary Heisenberg Group over a Finite Field

Let $(F,i)$ be a $K/k$-unitary space. The unitary Heisenberg group $H(F,i)$ consists of pairs $(w,z)$ with $w \in F$, $z \in K$, and

$$ \bar z-z=i(w,w), $$

with multiplication

$$ (w,z)(w',z')=(w+w',z+z'+i(w,w')). $$

Its center is identified with $k$, and $H(F,i)$ is a two-step nilpotent central extension

$$ 0 \to k \to H(F,i) \to F \to 0. $$

The unitary group $U(F,i)$ acts on $H(F,i)$ by $u(w,z)=(uw,z)$, fixing the center pointwise. If $q$ is odd, the symplectic Heisenberg group $H(E,j)$ attached to the underlying symplectic space is isomorphic to $H(F,i)$.
